title: Genie Code tasks in Lakeflow Jobs are now generally available
body: Genie Code tasks in Lakeflow Jobs are now generally available. A Genie Code task runs your prompt autonomously as part of a job. It can read upstream task outputs and call tools as needed, and it returns a link to the resulting Genie Code chat with its response. See [Genie Code task for jobs](/aws/en/jobs/tasks/genie-code).
